reconstruction_accuracy.unit: game units (a player is about 40 wide)
reconstruction_accuracy.excluded: victim coordinate (shares a writer with the track's death sample)

notes: line-of-sight is NOT included: it is an oracle upper bound and stays unvalidated until W6 (spec §6, §12)
recently_contested means an engagement was open, which the tracker holds for up to 15s after the last hit — not 'under attack'
distances are geometric separation, not tactical support distance
`gaps` names every player without a state here and why; a player is never simply absent
